1 Policy Overview & Scope

Surebound Insurance Services and its operating affiliates ("Surebound", "we", "us", or "our") provide personal, commercial, and specialty insurance brokerage, risk consultation, and underwriting administration. This Privacy Policy governs the collection, use, maintenance, and disclosure of information gathered from clients, prospective policyholders, and visitors across our digital portals, web properties, and offline communication channels.

We operate under strict compliance with the federal Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (15 U.S.C. § 6801 et seq.), state insurance department regulations, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA), and relevant state data privacy statutes.

Our Fundamental Pledge to You

Surebound does not, has never, and will never sell, lease, or monetize your non-public personal information (NPI) to third-party direct marketers, data brokers, or advertising networks.

2 Information We Collect

In order to provide accurate rate quotes, bind policies, underwrite risk factors, manage claims, and process premium billing, we collect non-public personal information from the following categories:

  • Personal Identifiers: Legal full name, residential and business addresses, date of birth, Social Security Number (SSN), Employer Identification Number (EIN), driver’s license number, email address, and phone numbers.
  • Underwriting & Property Details: Physical properties, vehicle identification numbers (VIN), property square footage, fire protection class, construction type, prior insurance loss history, and credit-based insurance risk scores where permitted by state law.
  • Financial & Billing Data: Bank account numbers (ACH), debit/credit card details, payment history, and policy financing arrangements.
  • Claims & Incident Information: Photos, police reports, medical payment reports, loss estimates, recorded statements, and legal correspondence regarding insurance claims.
  • Technical & Portal Information: IP addresses, browser specifications, login timestamps, device metadata, and interaction events logged in our policyholder portal.

3 How We Utilize Your Information

All gathered data is strictly applied toward legitimate insurance, underwriting, and policyholder service functions, including:

  • Generating competitive quote estimates and evaluating insurable risk profile suitability.
  • Binding, issuing, amending, and renewing insurance policies with appointed carrier underwriters.
  • Investigating, adjusting, and resolving insurance claims with prompt fair settlements.
  • Processing premium payments, setting up automated recurring billing, and issuing official invoices.
  • Complying with statutory reporting requirements established by State Insurance Commissioners, state DMVs, and the National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC).
  • Preventing financial crimes, identity theft, and fraudulent insurance transactions.

4 Information Sharing & Third-Party Disclosures

We do not disclose non-public personal information about our current or former customers to anyone, except as permitted or required by law. Routine disclosures necessary to maintain your coverage include:

  • Appointed Insurance Carriers & Reinsurers: Underwriting syndicates and insurance carriers who evaluate risk, issue binders, and back policy coverages.
  • Claims Adjusters & Independent Investigators: Third-party administrators, loss adjusters, repair shops, and legal counsel working directly on active claims.
  • Financial Institutions & Processors: PCI-DSS compliant credit card processors, Plaid, and ACH payment gateways for secure premium execution.
  • Regulatory & Law Enforcement Bodies: State departments of insurance, subpoenaed court orders, or mandatory anti-fraud auditing agencies.

5 Data Safeguards & Enterprise Encryption

Surebound maintains industry-leading technical, administrative, and physical safeguards designed to guarantee the confidentiality and integrity of your sensitive records:

  • 256-Bit SSL/TLS Encryption: All data transmissions across our public website, portals, and payment gateways are shielded using high-grade end-to-end encryption.
  • Role-Based Access Controls: Access to policyholder records is strictly limited to credentialed advisors and underwriters on a least-privilege, need-to-know basis.
  • Audited Infrastructure: Regular vulnerability scanning, penetration assessments, and encrypted offsite backups protected against unauthorized access.

6 Your Rights & Policyholder Preferences

Depending on your state of residence, you may possess specific legal rights concerning your personal information:

  • Right to Inspect & Correct: You have the right to review non-public personal information stored in your file and request corrections to any inaccuracies.
  • Communication Preferences: You can opt out of promotional newsletters or policy advisory communications at any time while continuing to receive essential legal, billing, and claims notices.
  • California & State Specific Disclosures: California residents can submit verified consumer requests under the CCPA/CPRA to access or delete personal records not retained under statutory insurance record-keeping mandates.

7 Cookies & Digital Tracking

Our websites utilize session and persistent cookies to remember your portal authentication state, ensure form security (CSRF protection), and analyze anonymous site performance trends. You may disable cookies through your browser settings, though doing so may impact interactive portal capabilities.
